name: Realistic Dataset Scale
description: Checks that the lab is working from a substantial feedback corpus and historical release dataset rather than a handful of hard-coded examples.
testCode:
import main
assert len(main.FEEDBACK) >= 900, f'Expected >=900 feedback rows, got {len(main.FEEDBACK)}'
assert len(main.HISTORICAL) >= 300, f'Expected >=300 historical release rows, got {len(main.HISTORICAL)}'
assert len(main.CANDIDATES) == 12

name: TF-IDF Matching Is Empirically Defensible
description: Evaluates the student's chosen similarity threshold against the analyst-audited subset of customer feedback.
testCode:
import main
from data_pipeline import evaluate_audited_matches
main.validate_student_choices()
matches = main.MATCHER.match_all(main.NLP_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD)
metrics = evaluate_audited_matches(matches)
assert metrics['audited_count'] >= 200
assert metrics['accuracy'] >= 0.70, f"Audited NLP accuracy is only {metrics['accuracy']:.3f}; inspect the threshold sweep."

name: Current Requirements Use the Historical Feature Schema
description: Checks that NLP-derived evidence is joined with product telemetry and engineering estimates without invented business-value scores.
testCode:
import main
from data_pipeline import aggregate_feedback
from priority_model import DEFAULT_FEATURES
main.validate_student_choices()
matches = main.MATCHER.match_all(main.NLP_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD)
evidence = aggregate_feedback(matches, main.CANDIDATES)
rows = main.build_current_feature_rows(main.CANDIDATES, evidence)
assert len(rows) == len(main.CANDIDATES)
by_id = {row['id']: row for row in rows}
for requirement in main.CANDIDATES:
    row = by_id[requirement['id']]
    for feature in DEFAULT_FEATURES:
        assert feature in row, f"Missing feature {feature} for {requirement['id']}"
    assert row['feedback_mentions_90d'] == evidence[requirement['id']]['feedback_mentions_90d']
    assert abs(row['mean_feedback_severity'] - evidence[requirement['id']]['mean_feedback_severity']) < 1e-9
    assert row['affected_mau'] == requirement['affected_mau']
    assert row['engineering_days'] == requirement['engineering_days']

name: Chosen Model Has Reproducible Cross-Validated Performance
description: Checks the selected scikit-learn model using 5-fold macro-F1 on historical release decisions.
testCode:
import main

main.validate_student_choices()

name: Model Produces Valid Release Probabilities
description: Trains the selected model and verifies that every current requirement receives a valid P(SHIPPED_NEXT).
testCode:
import main
from data_pipeline import aggregate_feedback
from priority_model import train_model, shipped_probability
main.validate_student_choices()
matches = main.MATCHER.match_all(main.NLP_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD)
evidence = aggregate_feedback(matches, main.CANDIDATES)
rows = main.build_current_feature_rows(main.CANDIDATES, evidence)
model = train_model(main.HISTORICAL, main.MODEL_FEATURES, main.MODEL_KIND)
probabilities = shipped_probability(model, rows, main.MODEL_FEATURES)
assert len(probabilities) == len(rows)
assert all(0.0 <= float(p) <= 1.0 for p in probabilities)
assert max(probabilities) - min(probabilities) > 0.05, 'Model is not meaningfully differentiating the backlog.'

name: Release Optimizer Respects Budget and Dependencies
description: Checks the deployed AI release against the engineer-day budget and unmet prerequisite rules.
testCode:
import main
from data_pipeline import aggregate_feedback
from priority_model import train_model, shipped_probability
main.validate_student_choices()
matches = main.MATCHER.match_all(main.NLP_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD)
evidence = aggregate_feedback(matches, main.CANDIDATES)
rows = main.build_current_feature_rows(main.CANDIDATES, evidence)
model = train_model(main.HISTORICAL, main.MODEL_FEATURES, main.MODEL_KIND)
probs = shipped_probability(model, rows, main.MODEL_FEATURES)
values = {row['id']: float(p) for row, p in zip(rows, probs)}
plan = main.optimize_release(rows, values)
assert plan['days_used'] <= main.MAX_RELEASE_DAYS
selected_ids = {row['id'] for row in plan['selected']}
for row in plan['selected']:
    prereq = row.get('prerequisite', '')
    ready = int(row.get('prerequisite_ready', 0))
    assert (not prereq and ready == 1) or ready == 1 or prereq in selected_ids, f"Unmet prerequisite for {row['id']}"

name: No Invented Business-Value Shortcut
description: Ensures the deployed feature table does not reintroduce arbitrary business_value or strategic_fit numbers.
testCode:
import main
from data_pipeline import aggregate_feedback
main.validate_student_choices()
matches = main.MATCHER.match_all(main.NLP_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD)
evidence = aggregate_feedback(matches, main.CANDIDATES)
rows = main.build_current_feature_rows(main.CANDIDATES, evidence)
for row in rows:
    assert 'business_value' not in row
    assert 'strategic_fit' not in row
